scope: DATASET_1_NSD_IMAGERY only (Dataset 2 / Spatial Imagery NOT reconstructed)
rationale: Method reconstructed sufficiently for scientific comparison (partial identifiability, no material mismatch). The perception->imagery PREDICTION and the cortical INCREASE in visual<->imagery subspace ALIGNMENT were directionally reproduced. However the paper's CENTRAL early-visual DIMENSIONAL-COMPRESSION result was NOT reproduced: the independent reconstruction estimated imagery dimensionality GREATER than visual dimensionality in early visual cortex (ratio ~1.47 vs ~0.5). Early-cortex alignment magnitudes were also substantially higher than reported (V1 ~0.70 vs ~0.25-0.30). Feature/tuning correspondence (Fig 5C-E) was not evaluated. A central directionally-discordant claim blocks SUPPORTED; concordant prediction and alignment domains preclude NOT_SUPPORTED; sufficient method identifiability precludes PUBLIC_METHODS_INSUFFICIENT. Therefore the Dataset-1 scientific result is PARTIALLY reproduced.
exact_replication_limitation: No exact/bitwise replication: original author code and random seeds are unavailable; B0 is b2-COMPATIBLE, not author-bitwise-confirmed.
dataset_2_limitation: Dataset 2 (Spatial Imagery) NOT independently reconstructed; no claim about it.
